extracted.intended_audience: Researchers, research staff and organisations preparing to apply for UKRI funding
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for prospective applicants and organisations on eligibility checks, required roles, available support, and council-specific rules to determine whether a project and organisation can apply to UK Research and Innovation (UKRI) funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find out if you can apply for funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Steps to find out if UKRI will fund your project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-level prompt to perform checks before applying — use the linked steps/resources to confirm project fit with UKRI priorities and funding availability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check organisation eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: A list of organisations we have approved to apply for funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must confirm their organisation is on UKRI's approved organisations list before applying; if not, see guidance on applying to become eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Individual eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria applicants need to meet, including your relationship with an eligible organisation and residency status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify personal eligibility requirements such as employment/affiliation with an eligible organisation and any residency or nationality conditions that apply to the specific funding opportunity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project role types
rubrics_metrics.description: Descriptions of the kinds of role you could include in an application and how to use them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the role-type descriptions to assign appropriate roles (e.g., PI, co-investigator, collaborator) in the application and ensure each role meets scheme-specific expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply to become an eligible organisation
rubrics_metrics.description: How you can apply to have your organisation approved to apply for funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organisations not on the approved list may follow this process to gain eligibility; plan ahead because approval is required before submitting applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demand management for funding applications
rubrics_metrics.description: How we limit the number of applications for some funding opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware some competitions impose applicant or institutional limits; check demand management rules to avoid submitting ineligible or excess applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Infraportal
rubrics_metrics.description: Find research and innovation structures and facilities that you could use for your research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Infraportal to identify facilities and infrastructure resources relevant to your project and include appropriate access/cost information in applications where required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find business and research partners
rubrics_metrics.description: Organisations that will help you find a partner to collaborate with.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your proposal requires collaborators or industry partners, use these partner-finding services to identify suitable partners and evidence of collaboration for the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disability and accessibility support
rubrics_metrics.description: The support we can offer during the application process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact UKRI for adjustments or accessibility assistance during the application process; include any required declarations or documentation as specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: What we've funded
rubrics_metrics.description: Details on the projects we've funded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review past funded projects to understand the types of projects and scope UKRI funds; use examples to judge alignment and to strengthen case for impact/feasibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Council specific guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Check the council guidance to see what specific criteria may apply to your research: (AHRC, BBSRC, ESRC, EPSRC, Innovate UK, MRC, NERC, STFC, Research England).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Different UKRI councils have council-specific eligibility rules, priorities and application requirements — applicants should consult the relevant council guidance linked on the page for scheme-specific criteria and processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research England funding process
rubrics_metrics.description: Research England uses a different process. Most of its funding is allocated to eligible higher education institutes based on their Research Excellence Framework assessment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If seeking funding through Research England, note it predominantly allocates funds to HEIs via REF outcomes rather than individual project competitions; follow the alternative process described.
